{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, prioritization, and tracking of progress.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier.
- **Title** – Short descriptive name.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for initial exploration.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected / Implemented.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Create a new entry following the structure above.
2. Assign an owner and set the priority.
3. Update status as the idea moves through the review process.

## Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Chatbot
Description: Develop a chatbot that uses GPT-4 to answer customer queries.
Owner: Jane Doe
Priority: 5
Status: Proposed
Notes: Requires integration with CRM.
```

Feel free to add more sections or modify the template as needed.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeas.md"}

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, prioritization, and tracking of progress.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier.
- **Title** – Short descriptive name.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for initial exploration.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected / Implemented.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Create a new entry following the structure above.
2. Assign an owner and set the priority.
3. Update status as the idea moves through the review process.

```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Chatbot
Description: Develop a chatbot that uses GPT-4 to answer customer queries.
Owner: Jane Doe
Priority: 5
Status: Proposed
Notes: Requires integration with CRM.
```
